integrity: The result is supported by a general symbolic proof and a separately implemented exact finite census for nine finite fields. The finite census is corroboration, not proof for all prime powers. This is a self-review, not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform invertible structure matrices relative to a fixed ordered natural basis; the random sample is not uniform on isomorphism classes. Only dimension two. Zero idempotent excluded. Geometric multiplicities and singular matrix distributions are not counted. The odd-characteristic law is the substantive new portion; even characteristic was covered by earlier methods. Broader historical implications have not been exhaustively excluded.
title: Exact finite-field idempotent law for two-dimensional perfect evolution algebras
